Product Details: The XTRA POWER Screwdriver Bits are a reliable and versatile addition to any toolkit, whether you are a professional tradesperson or a DIY enthusiast. This pack includes 10 pieces of PH2 Phillips head bits, available in two practical lengths — 65mm and 100mm — giving you the flexibility to tackle a wide range of fastening tasks with ease. The PH2 size is one of the most commonly used screwdriver bit sizes, making this set highly practical for everyday use in woodworking, furniture assembly, electrical work, and general repairs. Crafted for durability, these bits are designed to deliver consistent torque and a secure fit, reducing the risk of cam-out and wear over time. The extended 100mm length is particularly useful for reaching screws in deep or confined spaces, while the 65mm bits are ideal for standard applications. Compatible with most power drills and screwdrivers, these bits are a must-have for any workshop or toolbox. The pack of 10 ensures you always have a spare on hand when you need it most.
